signed_off_mapping_invariant.layerid_semantics: LayerID = Sci_bar copyNo = bar depth index
signed_off_mapping_invariant.ordering: LayerID 0 = most-upstream entrance bar (-> B2); monotonic increasing depth to LayerID 7 (-> B8); no interleaving
signed_off_mapping_invariant.b_arm_geometry: 8 contiguous 2 cm PSci bars, 16 cm total, zero gaps, fully active

quantities: S23 per-stave B4/B6/B8 MC occupancy shares
carried_mapping_conditional.reason: GEANT4 has 8 undifferentiated fully-active bars with no read/unread attribute; paired(4x4cm staves) vs odd-even(4x2cm, alternate bars read) is a hardware fact the sim cannot resolve

correction: The prior 'MV3 v4 closed the mapping -> paired stands' claim is overstated: paired is only the marginal best-chi2 variant (best chi2/ndf still ~554, entangled with gain/trigger); it is a data-chi2 preference, not an independent geometry validation.
